summary.title: New Threat Model
summary.description:
The Privacy-Enhanced Resort and Vacancy Online system is designed as a service-oriented architecture supporting guest booking, luxury service logistics, privacy-preserving identity management, billing, and physical security monitoring.

The system is divided into three primary data domains. First, a guest identity domain stores real guest information required for billing, legal obligations and identity verification. Second, an operational domain stores pseudonymized guest records used for bookings, room assignments, preferences and concierge services in order to preserve guest discretion. Third, a media domain stores surveillance footage and extracted facial metadata collected from cameras deployed across the resort premises.

Guests and staff access the system through a booking and management web application, authenticated through an external identity provider. Internally, a pseudonymization service separates real identities from operational records. For physical security, surveillance cameras send video streams to a media database, where an AI-based face recognition service extracts face embeddings and forwards identity resolution requests to an identity resolver service. Authorized security staff can review alerts and footage through a monitoring dashboard.

Trust boundaries exist between external users and internal services, between the core application services and the protected databases, between the surveillance infrastructure and the AI processing pipeline, and between the resort system and the external identity provider.

data.description: A third-party authentication service that verifies users and issues authentication tokens.

data.description: An external camera system that captures video streams and sends footage to the surveillance subsystem for storage and AI analysis.

data.description: Front-end application used for guest booking, registration, and staff operations.

data.description: Core backend service for reservations, room allocation, and resort logistics.

data.description: Service that separates real identities from pseudonymized operational records.

data.description: Service responsible for guest billing and payment processing.

data.name: AI Face Recognition
data.description: AI service that extracts and compares facial features from surveillance footage.

data.name: Media Linker API
data.description: API that links detected faces in media to identity resolution workflows.

data.name: Security Dashboard
data.description: Monitoring interface used by staff to review alerts, footage, and access events.

data.name: Guest Identity DB
data.description: Stores real guest identities and billing-related personal information.

data.description: Stores pseudonymized booking, logistics, and guest service records.
